jobs.occupation: International Clinician Scientist (f/d/m) for iPRACTIS (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. Forschung, Lehre, Krankenversorgung und Administration arbeiten im Integrationsmodell auf dem MHH-Campus Hand in Hand.
About us

Hannover Medical School (MHH) is offering positions in the international clinician scientist program (iPRACTIS), a unique opportunity for internationally mobile researchers with a completed medical degree outside of Germany. Over three years, you will gain experience in translational research while working towards medical degree recognition in Germany.

iPRACTIS supports internationally trained researchers aiming to build careers in academic medicine. Over three years, participants will deepen their research experience on a translational research project while working towards integration into the German academic and healthcare system.

We offer

The international clinician scientist program iPRACTIS offers:

- 36 months of structured clinical and scientific training based on an individually tailored career plan
- Individualized support in navigating the process of medical degree recognition in Germany and developing German language proficiency
- Funding for materials, travel, and publication
- Individualized support from a personalized mentoring team
- A curriculum to acquire key competencies [including data management and analysis, GCP clinical investigator certification (GCP-Prüfarztkurs), project management]
- Regular evaluations and feedback meetings
- A full onboarding program and integration into a strong Clinician Scientist Network

Clinical expectations: Participants will achieve recognition of their medical qualifications along with sufficient German language skills for clinical practice, allowing future specialist training and medical practice in Germany.

Research expectations: Participants will develop as a R2 researcher (according to the European Framework for Research Careers), including submitting their first third-party funding application. Participants who complete this process will be ready to pursue an independent research career (R3) in roles such as assistant professor, principal investigator, or junior group leader.

Eligibility requirements

To apply, candidates must:

- Hold a completed medical degree (from outside Germany)
- Have initial research experience (completed R1 to early R2 based on European Framework for Research Careers)
- Have not yet completed specialist clinical training (residency or German 'Facharzt' / 'Weiterbildung' equivalent)
- Be committed to pursuing a career combining clinical practice and research

In order to consider your application, we require that you submit the completed "iPRACTIS Application Template" (download) as well as a cover letter and detailed resume (in table format), a declaration of consent and copies of certificates (medical examination certificates, doctoral degree certificates, high school diplomas, and other relevant certificates and documents. If the documents are not in German or English, a certified translation is requested). Please submit your application as a single PDF file directly to practis@mh-hannover.de. More information can be found at iPRACTIS.

External applications for iPRACTIS positions will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The deadline for internal applications is 05.01.2027.
For questions, please reach out to Dr. Thorsten Saenger: practis@mh-hannover.de.

jobs.occupation: Research Assistant (f/m/d) (Mathematiker/in)
jobs.description:
“The Martian Mindset - A scarcity-driven engineering paradigm” is a newly funded Cluster of Excellence and was established at the University of Bremen in 2026. In this context, a position is available as soon as possible, as a

Research Assistant (f/m/d) salary scale (German) 13 TV-L, 100 % (39.2 h per week)

limited until 30.6.2029 according to § 2 WissZeitVG.

Part-time work is generally possible and to be agreed with the respective project leaders.

The workplace and employment will be at the University of Bremen, Center of Applied Space Technology and Microgravity (ZARM) in the research group of Prof. Dr. Marc Avila. The University as an Employer:

With approximately 20,000 students and about 3,500 employees, the University of Bremen is a medium-sized university. It ranks among Germany’s leading universities in terms of external funding and research.

The Martian Mindset:

Our scientists are developing the “Martian Mindset” in order to rethink the production of materials and components from scratch. The scarcity of resources and extreme conditions on the red planet serve as a setting to develop a new paradigm of sustainability that will lay the foundations for a fossil-fuel-free production of materials and parts from scarce resources in a highly automated and resilient way. The Cluster of Excellence will thus contribute to the sustainable human exploration of space and power a green transition on Earth.

The challenging and interdisciplinary research in “The Martian Mindset” spans ten multifaceted foci across three areas, whereas this position is to be filled within the Research Area 1, Sourcing:

In this research area, we investigate how to produce high-added-value materials and chemicals from low-grade ores using atmospheric gases as the only source of carbon and nitrogen and without burning fossil fuels. The focus of this position falls under modelling and simulation of multiphase flows electrolysis systems.

This project aims at developing numerical models that faithfully describe the generation, detachment and interaction of bubbles in electrolytes. The initial focus is on the generation of oxygen in water electrolysis under terrestrial and Mars conditions, but the models developed will offer a robust framework extendable to molten salt electrolysis.

The gas dynamics in electrochemical cells spans multiple scales in space, from (sub)nanometer to cell size (mm), and similarly for time, which cannot be all resolved simultaneously. Accordingly, multiscale, multiphase models will be developed that parametrize the effect of the unresolved (small) scales. Results from other projects in the Cluster that focus on the nano and micro scales will be leveraged to inform parametrizations and/or train the models with machine-learning techniques. A central focus is the quantification of uncertainty in the multi-scale approach. The resulting model predictions will directly inform reactor design and optimization in collaboration with experimental groups in the Cluster.

This project enhances the “Martian Mindset” scarcity-driven engineering paradigm by paving the way for the accurate, robust design of electrochemical technologies on Earth and in space conditions.

More information on the other research foci, the project leaders and the Cluster of Excellence itself can be found on our website: www.mars.uni-bremen.de.

As a researcher in The Martian Mindset, working at one of the five participating institutions on the campus of the University of Bremen, you will join a vibrant and dynamic scientific community of internationally renowned researchers. You will be involved in innovative and challenging scientific projects and contribute to the advancement of the respective research field.

Your key tasks will include in particular:

• Develop mathematical multiscale, multiphase models of the gas dynamics in electrochemical cells

• Implement these models using python and CUDA based on our in-house codes

• Parametrize and train the models leveraging nano- and microscopic data from other numerical and in the Cluster

• Validate results with experiments performed in other projects in the Cluster

• Investigate the dependence of the gas dynamics on the parameters of the system (electrode material and surface roughness, potential, concentration of the electrolyte, etc.)

• Documenting, publishing, and presenting research findings through various channels, including academic journals and international conferences, usually in English

• Collaborating with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers to advance joint scientific projects and publications

• Actively participating in Martian Mindset events, such as retreats, seminars, summer schools, and workshops to foster knowledge sharing and collaboration, considering individual possibilities (e.g. compatibility with family responsibilities, impairments)

• Mandatory participation in our qualification program (see below)

• Developing and writing grant proposals to secure funding for research projects and initiatives

• After agreement, there is the possibility of performing teaching tasks independently

• Opportunity to pursue individual academic research (e.g., doctoral dissertation, habilitation, or work equivalent to a habilitation)

Requirements

We are looking for dynamic and open-minded personalities who enjoy conducting cutting-edge research in an interdisciplinary, international and diverse team. To succeed in this role, you should

• old a master’s degree in a relevant field such as Applied Mathematics, Physics, Aerospace/Mechanical/Chemical/Process Engineering or a related discipline.

• We also consider applicants who are in the final phase of their master’s degree program. Please note that submission of your master’s degree certificate is mandatory for employment.

• be proficient in English (spoken and written), e.g. CEF-level B2

• demonstrate the ability to work independently and manage time effectively

• show team spirit

• possess a collaborative mindset and strong communication skills

• exhibit analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

A willing to engage in interdisciplinary work and collaborate with colleagues from different fields of expertise is expected.

We offer:

• State-of-the-art, unique research infrastructure

• Opportunities for international collaborations and extended research stays in top laboratories around the world

• A comprehensive mentoring and qualification program (see below) tailored to your individual needs and goals to promote successful project completion and transition to leading positions in academia and industry

• Support from the Welcome Center of the U Bremen Research Alliance

• Depending on individual qualifications, a gross annual salary in accordance with the TV-L ranging from 57.112,44 € (Level 1) to 81.176,28 € (Level 6) for a full-time position (39.2 hours per week).

The university will determine the individual pay grade assignment based on relevant prior professional experience upon an offer of employment. Additional benefits, such as the annual bonus (“Christmas bonus”) and any career advancement opportunities within the advertised pay grade, are also dependent on this assignment. This is based on the applicable legal provisions of the TV-L (specifically § 16 TV-L). For civil servants, remuneration is governed in particular by the provisions of the Bremen Civil Service Remuneration Act (further information can be found here).

• An additional pension plan for public sector employees (VBL)

• 30 days of vacation per calendar year (based on a 5-day workweek)

• A diverse, forward-looking, and open corporate culture

• Support from a collegial, motivated team with a positive work environment

• Individual onboarding

• Opportunities for continuing education and professional development

• Work-life balance through flexible working hours (flex time) and the option to work remotely (subject to certain conditions)

• Free services as part of social and family counseling

• An active workplace health management program, including discounts at local sports clubs, gyms, and swimming pools (EGYM Wellpass)

• The option to use a Job-Ticket

• Numerous sports and cultural activities

• A variety of dining options in the Student Services cafeterias

Qualification concept

Together we will create an exceptional environment for research, education and innovation, where the Martian Mindset can flourish. Our qualification concept is designed to empower early-career researchers to become creative, versatile and responsible risk-takers, who will continue to develop and implement our scarcity driven engineering paradigm in leadership roles within academia and industry. To achieve this, we offer individualized supervision and training, with a strong advisory network of supervisors, mentors, and peers. Further information on our comprehensive qualification program is available online.

Do you have questions?

For general questions about the personnel selection procedure and for questions about the content of the advertised position, please do not hesitate to contact:

Prof. Dr. Marc Avila (mavila@uni-bremen.de)

jobs.description:
Job Title: Metabolic Engineer (m/f/d) 

Microbial CO2 Transformation Specialist 

10 September 2026 

☀️About Us: 

Join the COLIPIan family as a Metabolic Engineer and help us develop next-generation microbial CO₂ transformation processes. 

At COLIPI, we are developing sustainable bioprocesses that use renewable carbon, including CO₂, to produce valuable microbial lipids and biomaterials. Our technology combines unconventional CO₂-utilizing microorganisms, metabolic engineering, and advanced fermentation to create sustainable alternatives to conventional lipid production. 

We are looking for an experienced scientist who can combine experimental strain engineering with metabolic modelling, systems biology, enzyme engineering, and bioinformatics to improve our production strains systematically. 

🧑🏽‍🔬Key Responsibilities: 

- Identify, design, and optimize metabolic pathways for converting CO₂ into lipids and other microbial storage molecules. 
- Develop and implement strain-engineering strategies, including gene knock-outs, overexpression, heterologous pathway expression, promoter engineering, plasmid-based engineering, and CRISPR/Cas-based approaches. 
- Establish, curate, and apply genome-scale metabolic models of our unconventional production strains to identify metabolic bottlenecks, predict engineering targets, and guide strain development. 
- Select and optimize heterologous enzymes and apply enzyme-engineering approaches to improve enzyme activity, stability, expression, and performance within the host microorganism. 
- Analyze and interpret transcriptomics, metabolomics, genomic, and sequencing data to understand cellular physiology and identify new engineering opportunities. 
- Apply bioinformatics tools for genome annotation, pathway analysis, sequence comparison, enzyme identification, and promoter/regulatory-element prediction. 
- Develop genetic tools and engineering strategies for COLIPI's unconventional CO₂-utilizing microbial strains. 
- Plan, execute, and analyze metabolic and genetic engineering experiments and translate results into iterative strain-development strategies. 
- Work closely with fermentation and analytical teams to evaluate engineered strains under relevant cultivation and gas-fermentation conditions. 

🛠️Qualifications: 

- PhD in Metabolic Engineering, Synthetic Biology, Systems Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or a related field, ideally combined with relevant academic and/or industry experience. 
- Strong background in microbial metabolic engineering, molecular biology, genetic engineering, and synthetic biology. 
- Hands-on experience with strain-engineering techniques such as knock-out/overexpression, cloning, heterologous gene expression, CRISPR/Cas, and directed evolution. 
- Demonstrated experience with genome-scale metabolic modelling and constraint-based metabolic analysis, ideally including model reconstruction or curation and experience with metabolic-modelling tools such as COBRApy, COBRA Toolbox, CellNetAnalyzer, etc.  
- Experience analyzing omics datasets, particularly transcriptomics and metabolomics, using computational and bioinformatics tools. 
- Good programming and data-analysis skills, ideally in Python and/or R. 
- Knowledge of enzyme engineering, protein structure-function relationships, and optimization of heterologous enzymes for activity and stability in thermophilic host microbe. 
- Strong understanding of microbial physiology, central carbon metabolism, carbon fixation pathways, metabolic regulation, and cellular redox/cofactor metabolism. 
- Familiarity with fermentation processes; experience with gas fermentation, autotrophic organisms, C1 metabolism, or non-model microorganisms is a strong advantage. 
- Experience with lipid/fatty-acid metabolism or engineering of acetyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA pathways is advantageous. 
- Ability to work independently, develop scientific strategies, and contribute to building and leading a highly effective strain-engineering team. 
- Legal permit to work in Europe, fluent in English (German B2 advantageous). 
- Willingness to embrace startup dynamics and help establish scalable scientific processes for future growth. 

🥰We Offer: 

- Competitive salary and 28 days of paid holidays 
- Steep learning and growth curve 
- Laptop and personal safety gear (goggles, coat, shoes) and training  
- Be part of an international team, blending academia with passionate startup vibes

- Access a fully equipped lab, cutting-edge technology, and ample room for personal development

jobs.occupation: Director Corporate M&A (all genders) part-/full-time (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your role:

As Senior Project Manager (all genders) you will be responsible for planning, coordinating and implementing M&A projects (acquisition and sale processes, joint ventures and strategic investments).

You will use your expertise to support the divisions and companies of our Group at all stages of the M&A process. You will manage interdisciplinary project groups comprising experts from both the divisions and central functions and external consultants. You will develop project plans, organize project meetings and will report on the progress of these projects on a regular basis. Your tasks will include analyzing and evaluating companies and transactions according to quantitative and qualitative criteria. You will work closely with the Business Development units within the divisions. You will support Controlling in producing company valuation models (DCF models) and will back the results with other valuation approaches. You will also organize and manage due diligence processes and will summarize the results. You will conduct negotiations and will work closely with both the legal department and external legal advisors to create the relevant legal documentation, taking into account the input from all the relevant specialist departments. Last but not least, you will prepare decision papers, present these to top management and coordinate key activities following the successful completion of transactions.

Who you are:

- Degree in business administration with specialization in finance or a university degree in another subject with an additional business qualification (e.g. MBA)
- At least five years of professional experience working in M&A at a company, at a Private Equity firm, in investment banking or in relevant fields within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or chemical industries
- Experience in project management and ideally in an international environment
- Highly structured working style and analytical mindset
- Team-oriented and strong communication skills
- Ability to motivate teams
- Strong organizational skills and ability to cope with pressure
- Reliability and flexibility
- Willingness to travel on business
- Ability to conduct negotiations in English

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!
